items.title: Lionel Hampton interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: we played against Basie at the Savoy Ballroom in New York

ctx.x: Did you ever have occasion to have your band play opposite the other great groups, like Ellington or Basie?
Yeah, we played against Basie at the Savoy Ballroom in New York. And I don’t want to be stuck up, in no kind of way, but we ran Basie out of the hole that night.
Ran ‘em out, huh? Well you guys had quite a show too, I mean, you were great showmen as well as great musicians, right?
